text: review.json for 13 repos: 3 read-only subagents on sonnet proposed each repo's sensitive paths; this session checked every glob against git ls-files and wrote the files

outcome: about 5 minutes and 395K sonnet tokens across 3 agents; all 102 globs matched real files on the first try; they also surfaced a committed .env with API keys in wallstbets and a real-looking Discord token in tablehand's .env.example
